brief:
Israeli soldiers serving in Gaza have reported severe psychological effects from their deployment, according to Al Jazeera English. Many account for symptoms including anxiety, sleep disturbances, and moral injury stemming from their combat experiences and what they witnessed during operations in the territory.

Despite describing their own suffering, numerous soldiers have expressed minimal or no remorse regarding the impact of their actions on Palestinian civilians. The disconnect between soldiers' reported trauma and their apparent lack of accountability for Palestinian casualties forms the core focus of the reporting.
dek: Israeli soldiers describe the psychological toll of the genocide in Gaza, yet many express no remorse.
title: Israeli soldiers describe Gaza trauma while showing little remorse for Palestinians
